name: MemoryGuard
description: Local-first MCP memory backend and governance console for coding agents. Auto-organize, quarantine, supersede, and rollback shared memories. 22 MCP tools. SQLite backend. No account, no server, no telemetry.

tools.name: memoryguard_memory_read
tools.description: Read a single memory record by ID

tools.name: memoryguard_memory_search
tools.description: Search memories by query, kind, or status

tools.name: memoryguard_memory_write
tools.description: Write a new memory; auto-organizes on write

tools.name: memoryguard_binding_create
tools.description: Bind an agent to a share group

tools.name: memoryguard_explain
tools.description: Explain a finding's evidence and risk

tools.name: memoryguard_build_plan
tools.description: Generate a memory build plan (no write)

tools.name: memoryguard_external_mcp_import
tools.description: Import an external MCP descriptor (L0-L4 classification)

tools.name: memoryguard_extract_memories
tools.description: Extract memory segments from a source file (read-only preview)

tools.name: memoryguard_accept_candidates
tools.description: Accept extracted candidates and write to shared memory

tools.name: memoryguard_semantic_check
tools.description: Check text for semantic duplicates / conflicts
